messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "doses greater than 6 mg/kg body weight are not recommended"
set: ["doses greater than 6 mg/kg body weight are not recommended", "doses above 0.61 mg/kg or greater than 40 mg", "total daily doses above 50 mg are not recommended", "patients taking higher than recommended doses", "greater than 95%", "Amrix extended-release capsules are not recommended", "do not take more than recommended", "doses are based on weight in children", "do not take more than recommended dose", "doses administered for more than 6 days have not been studied", "pediatric patients greater than or equal to 6 years of age", "serious breathing problems not reported at recommended doses", "experience with daily doses greater than 20 mg is very minimal", "taking more than recommended dose does not increase effectiveness", "starting is not recommended", "includes cisplatin doses of 50 mg/m2 or greater"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
